tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and nav bars sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Hero bands, footers and score cards. Text on it is surface-inverse-text.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, chips and secondary controls (3:1 against surface-raised).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running copy and descriptions.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata and helper text. 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Court blue. Main actions, selected time slots, links, focus. Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary fills and links.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary (5.3:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip, selected row and ghost-button hover fill.

tokens.name: primary-tint-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-tint.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ball lime. The one spark per screen: the Book or Join action, level 6+ badge. Always a fill, always with on-accent text. Never text on light grounds (1.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (14:1).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Peak-hour time slots and highlighted rows. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Border of accent-tint surfaces.

tokens.name: court-700
tokens.usage: Deep court blue for illustration and outdoor court art.

tokens.name: court-900
tokens.usage: Darkest court blue for illustration and indoor court art.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed text and icons. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Almost-full and expiring text and icons. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and cancelled text and icons. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons, white text (5.6:1).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled controls and booked slots.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Text on disabled-bg. Exempt from contrast, so never carry the only meaning.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px ring with a 3 px gap, on every focusable element.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headings on the website. Uppercase.

styles.name: numeric-l
styles.usage: Scores and the next-match time. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: numeric-m
styles.usage: Times, prices and level numbers on cards. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Pick a slot, invite your three and walk on court.

styles.name: body-m
styles.sample: Courts are held while you check out.
styles.usage: Default body text in app and web.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and slots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone screen margin and default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on web.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between card groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside a block.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Web page padding and the gap between website sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags and inline highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, time slots and list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: List rows and date pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Court, match and player cards.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modals.
